checklist.step: Inventory every tax-relevant control point across §807, §831(b), §846 and §848 computations
actions: Pull the prior-year control matrix from the compliance evidence repository and the current chart of accounts extract from SAP S/4HANA (GL).

Walk the close checklist with the Tax Manager to identify every account and computation feeding reserve discounting (§846), DAC capitalization (§848), and if applicable the §831(b) captive premium/diversification test.
Add or retire control lines so the matrix matches the current legal entity structure and elections on file.
Tag each control line with its control objective, frequency and control owner.
checklist.done: the control matrix lists every account and computation touching §807/§831(b)/§846/§848 with an owner and frequency assigned.

checklist.step: Document the control activity narrative for each control point
actions: For each control line, write the control activity narrative: what is checked, against what source, and what evidence is produced.
For the §846 discounting control, describe how the applicable federal interest rate and loss payment pattern are sourced and applied to unpaid losses.
For the §848 control, describe how net premiums are multiplied by the specified capitalization percentage (2.09%/2.45%/9.20% by line) and amortized.
Route the draft narrative to the Controller for review and to the Tax Director for technical sign-off.
checklist.done: every control line has an approved narrative describing the check, its source data and the evidence it produces.

checklist.step: Assign control owners and confirm segregation of duties
actions: List the preparer and reviewer for each control line and confirm no individual both prepares and reviews the same computation.
Cross-check preparer/reviewer assignments against the Identity & Access (shared authorization) role list for the GL and tax provision systems.
Escalate any segregation-of-duties conflict to the CFO for a compensating control decision.
Record the final owner assignments in the control matrix header.
checklist.done: every control line shows a distinct preparer and reviewer with no unresolved segregation-of-duties conflict.

checklist.step: Configure system access and change controls around the tax-relevant GL accounts
actions: In SAP S/4HANA (GL) review the authorization roles that can post to the reserve-discounting, DAC and captive-premium accounts.
Confirm posting access is limited to Accounting and Tax personnel named on the control matrix.
Request IT Security remove any access held by personnel outside the named list.
Capture the access review screenshot and file it with the control matrix.
checklist.done: GL posting access to tax-relevant accounts matches the named control owners with no unauthorized access.

checklist.step: Run the annual §831(b) premium ceiling and diversification check where the election is in effect
actions: Pull net written premium for each electing captive/affiliate from the ceded accounting platform for the tax year.
Compare total net written premium to the current-year §831(b) inflation-adjusted ceiling published by the IRS.
Test the diversification requirement (no more than 20% of net written premium from any one policyholder, absent the relatedness safe harbor) using the policyholder premium breakdown.
Record pass/fail and the underlying figures on the control matrix line for the year.
checklist.done: the §831(b) ceiling and diversification test is computed and recorded for every electing entity, with pass/fail stated.

checklist.step: Perform the walkthrough of each control with the control owner
actions: Schedule a walkthrough session with each control owner and observe the control being performed on a live period's data.
Request the underlying support (rate tables, capitalization percentage schedule, premium extracts) used in the computation.
Note any deviation between the documented narrative and what was actually performed.
Log walkthrough notes in AuditBoard against the corresponding control line.
checklist.done: every control line has a completed walkthrough note in AuditBoard, dated and cross-referenced to supporting evidence.

checklist.step: Test the design of the segregation of duties and system access controls
actions: Re-pull the current GL posting access list and compare it to the control matrix's named preparer/reviewer list.
Flag any mismatch as a design or operating gap.
Confirm password/access review evidence exists for the review period.
Record results in the walkthrough workpaper.
checklist.done: access matches the control matrix, or every mismatch is logged as a gap.

checklist.step: Evaluate identified gaps for materiality and compensating controls
actions: For every gap logged by Internal Audit, assess whether a compensating control exists and document it.
Where no compensating control exists, classify the gap as a control deficiency, significant deficiency, or material weakness using the CFO's severity framework.
Route material weaknesses to the CFO and Chief Audit Executive immediately, not at quarter-end.
Record the classification and rationale in the deficiency log.
checklist.done: every gap has a documented materiality classification and, where applicable, a named compensating control.

checklist.step: Build and approve remediation plans for open deficiencies
actions: For each open deficiency, define the remediation action, target completion date and evidence that will demonstrate closure.
Get the Controller's sign-off on the remediation plan before work begins.
Track plan status weekly until closure; escalate any plan slipping past its target date to the CFO.
Update the SOX/tax control tracker with plan status.
checklist.done: every open deficiency has an approved remediation plan with a target date tracked to closure.

checklist.step: Re-test remediated controls before closing them
actions: Re-perform the walkthrough for each remediated control using a period after the fix date.
Confirm the fix addresses the root cause, not just the symptom flagged originally.
Close the deficiency in the tracker only after the re-test passes.
File the re-test evidence in AuditBoard against the original deficiency record.
checklist.done: every remediated control has a passing re-test on file before the deficiency is closed.

checklist.step: Brief the CFO and Tax Director on the year's control results
actions: Prepare a control summary memo: control count, walkthrough results, deficiencies identified, deficiencies closed, and open items with target dates.
Present the memo to the CFO and Tax Director ahead of the tax provision close.
Capture any directed changes to the control matrix for the next cycle.
File the signed memo in the compliance evidence repository.
checklist.done: a signed control summary memo exists and any directed changes are logged for the next cycle.

checklist.step: Update the control matrix for legal-entity and election changes
actions: Confirm with Legal and Tax Director whether any §831(b) elections were made, revoked or affiliates added/removed during the year.
Update the control matrix scope to reflect new or removed entities.
Re-run the segregation-of-duties check for any newly added control lines.
Version the control matrix and note the change reason in its revision log.
checklist.done: the control matrix reflects the current legal-entity and election structure with a versioned revision log entry.

checklist.step: Reconcile control matrix scope to the tax provision workpapers
actions: In OneStream (FP&A) open the current tax provision workpaper and list every line item computed.
Cross-check each provision line item traces back to a control line in the matrix.
Flag any provision line with no corresponding control and add it to the matrix.
Sign off the reconciliation and attach it to the annual control package.
checklist.done: every tax provision line item traces to a control matrix line with no unmatched items.

checklist.step: Retain the annual control package for the required period
actions: Assemble the control matrix, walkthrough notes, deficiency log and remediation evidence for the year into one package.
File the package in the compliance evidence repository under the tax year and legal entity.
Apply a 7-year retention label from the year-end date.
Confirm the package is indexed and retrievable by tax year and entity.
checklist.done: the annual control package is filed, labelled for 7-year retention and retrievable by year and entity.

checklist.step: Attest to control effectiveness ahead of the tax provision close
actions: Review the control summary memo, deficiency log and remediation status.
Sign the annual internal control attestation covering the tax-relevant accounts and computations.
Route the signed attestation to the Controller for filing with the control package.
Communicate any residual open item to the Audit Committee before the provision close.
checklist.done: a signed CFO attestation covering the tax control environment is filed with the control package before the provision close.

testing.step: Build the population of tax-relevant controls in scope for the year
actions: Extract the full control matrix as of fiscal year-end from the compliance evidence repository.
Reconcile the control count to the prior-year matrix plus any documented additions/retirements.
Resolve any unreconciled difference with the Controller before sampling.
testing.done: the control population is reconciled to the year's documented matrix changes and signed as complete.

testing.step: Select the control sample and document the method
actions: Select 100% of key controls (§846 discounting, §848 capitalization, §831(b) ceiling/diversification where elected).
Select a random, reproducible sample of remaining non-key controls, minimum 10 or 25% of the remainder, whichever is greater.
Record the seed, population size and selection date in the workpaper.
testing.done: the sample is drawn, reproducible, and covers 100% of key controls.

testing.step: Re-perform the §846 loss reserve discounting computation independently
actions: Pull the unpaid loss triangle and the applicable federal interest rate and loss payment pattern used for the year.
Independently recompute the discounted unpaid losses using the published discount factors.
Compare the independent result to the amount reported in the tax provision workpaper; a variance beyond rounding is an exception.
File the recomputation worksheet in the test evidence folder.
testing.done: the independent discounting recomputation matches the reported figure or the variance is logged as an exception.

testing.step: Re-perform the §848 DAC capitalization computation independently
actions: Pull net premiums written by specified insurance contract category for the year.

Apply the correct statutory capitalization percentage (2.09% annuity, 2.45% group life/health, 9.20% other) and the 10-year (15-year for pre-2018-method changes where applicable) amortization schedule.
Compare the independently computed capitalized amount and amortization to the tax provision workpaper.
Log any mismatch as an exception with the affected line of business.
testing.done: the independent §848 computation reconciles to the workpaper for every sampled line of business, or is logged as an exception.

testing.step: Re-perform the §831(b) ceiling and diversification test for sampled electing entities
actions: Pull net written premium by policyholder for each sampled electing entity from the ceded accounting platform.
Recompute total net written premium against the current-year inflation-adjusted ceiling.
Recompute the largest single-policyholder premium percentage against the 20% diversification threshold.
Compare to the control matrix's recorded pass/fail and log any disagreement.
testing.done: the independent §831(b) test agrees with the recorded result for every sampled electing entity, or a disagreement is logged.

testing.step: Verify segregation of duties on the sample
actions: Pull current GL and tax-system access listings for each sampled control's preparer and reviewer.
Confirm no individual holds both preparer and reviewer access for the same control.
Log any conflict found as an exception with the affected control line.
testing.done: no sampled control shows a preparer/reviewer access conflict, or every conflict is logged.

testing.step: Trace sampled control evidence to source data
actions: For each sampled control, trace the evidence filed in the control package to the underlying source system extract (GL, actuarial platform, ceded accounting platform).
Confirm dates and figures on the evidence match the source extract.
Log any untraceable or altered evidence as an exception.
testing.done: every sampled control's evidence traces to its source system, or the exception is logged.

testing.step: Assess deficiency classification and remediation closure evidence
actions: Pull the deficiency log and confirm each logged gap has a materiality classification and, where remediated, closure evidence with a re-test result.
Recompute the exception rate for the current test population.
Flag any deficiency closed without a documented re-test as an exception.
testing.done: every deficiency has a classification and, if closed, a documented re-test; unsupported closures are logged as exceptions.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue for each exception identified during testing with the control line, what failed, and the financial-statement/tax impact.
Assign a root cause and an owner from the Controller's team.
Set a remediation date and add the item as a mandatory retest for the next cycle.
Notify the CFO of any exception touching a key control.
testing.done: every test exception has an issue, root cause, owner, remediation date and mandatory retest flag.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test to the Audit Committee
actions: Compute the overall exception rate and compare it against the zero-tolerance threshold for key controls.
Write the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective) referencing the underlying workpapers.
Have an independent reviewer who performed none of the sampled re-performance sign the workpaper.
Present results to the Audit Committee and file the signed workpaper in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion and exception rate is filed and reported to the Audit Committee.

checklist.step: Scope the annual key-control test plan from the current control matrix
actions: Pull the current-year control matrix from the compliance evidence repository maintained by the Controller.
Classify each control line as key or non-key based on its financial-statement/tax impact and prior-year deficiency history.
Draft the test plan listing scope, sample sizes, and re-performance procedures per control line.
Route the draft plan to the Chief Audit Executive for approval before fieldwork starts.
checklist.done: an approved test plan exists naming every key control, its sample size and re-performance procedure.

checklist.step: Confirm access to source systems needed for re-performance
actions: Request read-only access to SAP S/4HANA (GL), the actuarial modeling platform and the ceded accounting platform through the IAM platform (SailPoint/Okta/Azure AD).
Confirm access is provisioned before fieldwork start date and scoped to read-only, no posting rights.
Log the access grant in AuditBoard with the requester and approval date.
checklist.done: read-only access to every source system in the test plan is provisioned and logged before fieldwork begins.

checklist.step: Pull the population of transactions/computations for each key control
actions: For the §846 discounting control, pull the full unpaid loss triangle by line of business for the tax year from the actuarial modeling platform.
For the §848 control, pull net premiums written by specified insurance contract category from the GL.
For §831(b) where elected, pull net written premium by policyholder from the ceded accounting platform.
Reconcile each pulled population to the amount reported in the tax provision workpaper before sampling.
checklist.done: each key control's population is pulled and reconciled to the tax provision workpaper.

checklist.step: Select the test sample and document the selection method
actions: Select 100% of key-control computations given the low population count typical of these controls.
Select a random, reproducible sample of at least 25% of non-key control instances.
Record the seed, population size and selection rationale in the AuditBoard workpaper.
checklist.done: the sample is documented with method, seed and population size in AuditBoard.

checklist.step: Re-perform the §846 discounting computation for the sample
actions: Open the actuarial modeling platform and re-derive the discount factors from the published applicable federal interest rate and the prescribed loss payment pattern for the line of business.
Apply the factors to the unpaid loss triangle and compute the discounted reserve independently.
Compare to the amount in the tax provision workpaper; note any variance beyond a de minimis rounding threshold.
Screenshot the computation into the AuditBoard workpaper.
checklist.done: an independent discounted-reserve figure is computed and compared to the workpaper for every sampled line of business.

checklist.step: Re-perform the §848 DAC capitalization computation for the sample
actions: Apply the statutory capitalization percentage for the contract category to the sampled net premium figure.
Recompute the amortization schedule using the applicable statutory useful life.
Compare the independent result to the tax provision workpaper and note any variance.
File the recomputation in AuditBoard.
checklist.done: an independent DAC capitalization figure is computed and compared to the workpaper for every sampled category.

checklist.step: Re-perform the §831(b) ceiling and diversification test where elected
actions: Recompute total net written premium against the current-year inflation-adjusted ceiling.
Recompute the largest single-policyholder premium share against the 20% threshold, applying the relatedness safe harbor rules where relevant.
Compare the independent result to the control matrix's recorded pass/fail.
Log any disagreement as an exception.
checklist.done: the independent §831(b) test result is compared to the recorded result for every sampled electing entity.

checklist.step: Test operating effectiveness of segregation of duties on the sample
actions: Pull the current access listing for each sampled control's preparer and reviewer.
Confirm the preparer and reviewer are distinct individuals with distinct system roles.
Log any conflict as an exception.
checklist.done: no sampled control shows a segregation-of-duties conflict, or every conflict is logged.

checklist.step: Evaluate and classify every exception found
actions: Group exceptions by root cause: data source error, wrong rate/percentage applied, manual override, or access conflict.
Assess materiality using the CFO's severity framework and classify each as deficiency, significant deficiency, or material weakness.
Route material weaknesses to the Chief Audit Executive and CFO within one business day of discovery.
Record classifications in the AuditBoard deficiency log.
checklist.done: every exception is classified with a documented root cause and materiality rating.

checklist.step: Agree remediation owners and target dates with the Controller
actions: Meet with the Controller and Tax Manager to assign a remediation owner and target date for each deficiency.
Confirm the remediation plan addresses the root cause, not just the symptom.
Log the agreed plan in AuditBoard against the deficiency.
Set a follow-up checkpoint at the midpoint of the target timeline.
checklist.done: every deficiency has an agreed owner, target date and root-cause-addressing remediation plan logged in AuditBoard.

checklist.step: Track remediation progress to closure
actions: Check remediation status against target dates weekly.
Escalate any plan slipping past its target date to the Chief Audit Executive.
Request evidence of the remediation action from the control owner as each plan nears completion.
Update status fields in AuditBoard.
checklist.done: remediation status is current in AuditBoard with no unescalated overdue plan.

checklist.step: Re-test remediated key controls before closing them
actions: Re-perform the original test procedure on a period after the remediation fix date.
Confirm the re-test passes before marking the deficiency closed.
File the re-test evidence against the original deficiency record in AuditBoard.
Notify the Chief Audit Executive of closure.
checklist.done: every remediated key control has a passing re-test filed before closure.

checklist.step: Prepare the annual test results summary
actions: Summarize population, sample size, exceptions found, exceptions closed, and open items by control.
Compute the overall exception rate for key and non-key controls separately.
Draft the conclusion narrative referencing the underlying workpapers.
Route the draft to the Chief Audit Executive for review.
checklist.done: a draft results summary with exception rates and a conclusion narrative is ready for Chief Audit Executive review.

checklist.step: Present results to the Audit Committee before the provision close
actions: Present the annual key-control test results, open deficiencies and remediation status to the Audit Committee.
Obtain committee acknowledgment of any material weakness before the tax provision closes.
Record committee questions and any directed follow-up action.
File the presentation and minutes in the compliance evidence repository.
checklist.done: the Audit Committee has reviewed the year's results and any directed follow-up is logged before provision close.

checklist.step: Retain the annual test package for the required period
actions: Assemble the test plan, workpapers, deficiency log, remediation evidence and committee materials into one package.
File the package in the compliance evidence repository under the tax year.
Apply the 7-year retention label.
Confirm the package is indexed and retrievable by tax year and control line.
checklist.done: the annual test package is filed, labelled for 7-year retention and retrievable by year and control.

testing.step: Build the population of control tests performed during the year
actions: Extract the full list of controls tested from the year's AuditBoard test plan.
Reconcile the tested-control count to the approved test plan scope.
Resolve any scope gap (a planned control not tested) before proceeding.
testing.done: the tested population reconciles to the approved test plan with no unexplained scope gap.

testing.step: Select a quality-assurance sample of completed tests
actions: Select 100% of key-control tests and a random 25% sample of non-key control tests for independent QA review.
Record the seed and selection date in the QA workpaper.
Confirm the selected sample covers every control classified as key in the current-year test plan.
testing.done: the QA sample is drawn and documented, covering 100% of key-control tests.

testing.step: Independently re-perform a subset of the re-performance procedures
actions: For each QA-sampled key control, independently redo the re-performance (discount factor, capitalization percentage, or §831(b) test) using the source data cited in the original workpaper.
Compare the QA result to the original tester's conclusion.
Log any disagreement as a QA exception with the original tester named.
testing.done: the QA re-performance agrees with the original test conclusion for every sampled key control, or a QA exception is logged.

testing.step: Trace workpaper evidence to source system extracts
actions: For each QA-sampled test, confirm the source data screenshot or extract in the workpaper matches a live pull from the system of record.
Confirm dates on the evidence are consistent with the test period.
Log any untraceable evidence as an exception.
testing.done: every QA-sampled workpaper's evidence traces to its source system, or the gap is logged.

testing.step: Verify sample selection methodology on the underlying tests
actions: Confirm each underlying test recorded a seed, population size and selection date consistent with a reproducible method.
Attempt to re-draw one sample using the recorded seed and confirm it matches the original sample.
Log any non-reproducible sample as a methodology exception.
testing.done: sample selection is reproducible for the QA-sampled tests, or the exception is logged.

testing.step: Recompute the exception and closure rates reported for the year
actions: Recompute the key- and non-key-control exception rates from the underlying deficiency log.
Compare the recomputed rates to the rates presented to the Audit Committee.
Log any discrepancy as a reporting exception and correct the reported figure.
testing.done: reported exception rates reconcile to the underlying deficiency log or are corrected.

testing.step: Verify remediation closures had a passing re-test on file
actions: Pull every deficiency marked closed during the year.
Confirm a re-test result exists and passed before the closure date.
Log any closure without a passing re-test as an exception and reopen the deficiency.
testing.done: every closed deficiency has a passing re-test on file, or is reopened as an exception.

testing.step: Confirm segregation between testers and control owners
actions: Confirm no Internal Audit tester on the sample also serves as a control preparer or reviewer for the same control.
Check reporting lines for any conflict of interest not otherwise disclosed.
Log any conflict as an independence exception.
testing.done: no independence conflict exists between testers and control owners on the sample, or it is logged.

testing.step: Log every QA exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue for each QA exception naming the original test, what was wrong, and the impact on the reported conclusion.
Assign a root cause and an owner within Internal Audit.
Set a remediation date and require the correction flow through to the Audit Committee reporting if the conclusion changes.
testing.done: every QA exception has an issue, root cause, owner and remediation date.

testing.step: Conclude on the reliability of the year's key-control testing and report
actions: Compute the QA exception rate and compare against the acceptable threshold for testing reliability.
Write the conclusion on whether the year's key-control test results can be relied upon as reported.
Have an independent reviewer outside the original test team sign the QA workpaper.
Report the QA conclusion to the Audit Committee and file the workpaper in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed QA workpaper with a stated reliability conclusion is filed and reported to the Audit Committee.

actions: Request a written independence confirmation letter from the audit engagement partner ahead of the current-year engagement letter signature.
Confirm the letter addresses AICPA/PCAOB independence rules including financial interests, employment relationships and non-audit services performed.
Log the letter's receipt date in AuditBoard against the engagement record.
Escalate to the Audit Committee chair if the letter is not received before fieldwork start.
checklist.done: a dated, signed independence letter from the engagement partner is filed in AuditBoard before fieldwork starts.

checklist.step: Pull and update the lead/concurring partner rotation tracker
actions: Open the AuditBoard rotation tracker and add the current year's tenure count for the lead and concurring engagement partners.
Confirm lead partner tenure has not exceeded 5 consecutive years and concurring partner tenure has not exceeded 7 consecutive years, per the applicable rotation rule.
Flag any partner approaching the rotation limit within the next two audit cycles.
Route flagged partners to the Chief Audit Executive for succession planning with the audit firm.
checklist.done: the rotation tracker is current for the year and any partner nearing the limit is flagged for succession planning.

checklist.step: Inventory all non-audit services proposed or performed by the audit firm
actions: Request from the Controller and Tax Director a list of any non-audit tax services (tax return preparation assistance, tax planning, tax opinion work) the incumbent firm proposes or has performed.
Cross-check each proposed service against the prohibited-services list (e.g., contingent-fee tax services, bookkeeping, appraisal/valuation for the client).
Flag any prohibited or borderline service for Audit Committee pre-approval before it is engaged.
Log the inventory and its disposition in AuditBoard.
checklist.done: every non-audit service proposed or performed is inventoried and dispositioned against the prohibited-services list.

checklist.step: Route non-audit tax service requests through Audit Committee pre-approval
actions: Prepare a pre-approval memo for each non-audit tax service request, describing the service, estimated fee and independence impact analysis.
Submit the memo to the Audit Committee (or its delegated chair, subject to ratification at the next full committee meeting) before the service begins.
Record the approval or denial decision and date in AuditBoard.
Notify the Tax Director of the outcome before the auditor is engaged for the service.
checklist.done: every non-audit tax service has a dated Audit Committee pre-approval or denial on file before work begins.

checklist.step: Assess financial and employment relationships for independence impairment
actions: Confirm no audit engagement team member holds a financial interest in the company per the independence letter representations.
Check whether any former audit firm employee joined the company in a financial-reporting oversight role within the applicable cooling-off period (commonly one year).
Cross-check new senior finance hires against the incumbent audit firm's alumni list for the relevant period.
Log any identified relationship for Chief Audit Executive review.
checklist.done: financial-interest and cooling-off-period checks are completed and any finding is logged for review.

checklist.step: Confirm the audit committee pre-approves the annual audit fee and scope
actions: Present the proposed annual audit fee, scope letter and any fee changes from the prior year to the Audit Committee.
Obtain committee approval before the engagement letter is countersigned.
Record the approved fee and scope in the board portal minutes.
File the approved engagement letter in AuditBoard.
checklist.done: the Audit Committee's approval of fee and scope is recorded in the minutes before the engagement letter is signed.

checklist.step: Verify the audit firm's own quality-control and PCAOB inspection status
actions: Request the audit firm's most recent PCAOB inspection report summary or peer review letter.
Confirm no unresolved quality-control finding materially affects the engagement team assigned to this audit.
Note the inspection date and outcome in the engagement acceptance memo.
Escalate any material finding to the Audit Committee before engagement renewal.
checklist.done: the audit firm's current inspection/peer-review status is documented in the engagement acceptance memo.

checklist.step: Document engagement acceptance decision and rationale
actions: Draft the engagement acceptance memo summarizing the independence letter, rotation status, non-audit service disposition and inspection status.
Route the memo to the Audit Committee chair for review ahead of the committee meeting.
Incorporate any committee comments before finalizing.
File the final memo in AuditBoard.
checklist.done: a finalized engagement acceptance memo covering all independence factors is filed before the engagement letter is signed.

checklist.step: Get Audit Committee approval of engagement acceptance/renewal
actions: Present the engagement acceptance memo to the full Audit Committee at its scheduled meeting.
Obtain a documented vote or consensus approving the engagement.
Record the approval in the board portal minutes with the meeting date.
Notify the Chief Audit Executive to proceed with engagement letter execution.
checklist.done: the Audit Committee's approval of the engagement is minuted before the engagement letter is executed.

checklist.step: Execute the engagement letter and file it centrally
actions: Route the final engagement letter for signature by the CFO and the audit firm's engagement partner.
Confirm the letter references the current-year scope, fee and any pre-approved non-audit services.
File the signed letter in AuditBoard and cross-reference it to the independence letter and committee approval.
checklist.done: the signed engagement letter is filed and cross-referenced to its supporting independence and approval evidence.

checklist.step: Monitor independence throughout the engagement period
actions: Send a mid-cycle independence attestation reminder to the audit engagement partner at the engagement midpoint.
Review any new non-audit service request that arises during the engagement against the pre-approval process.
Log any change in engagement team composition and screen new members for independence.
Report any mid-cycle finding to the Chief Audit Executive immediately.
checklist.done: a mid-cycle independence check is completed and any new finding is escalated promptly.

checklist.step: Assess and disposition any identified independence impairment
actions: Where an impairment is identified, determine whether it is material to the audit opinion's reliability with input from General Counsel.
Decide the disposition: remediate and continue, restrict the impaired individual from the engagement, or reassess the audit opinion.
Document the disposition rationale and get Audit Committee concurrence.
Log the impairment, disposition and concurrence date in AuditBoard.
checklist.done: every identified impairment has a documented disposition concurred by the Audit Committee.

checklist.step: Track rotation succession planning with the audit firm
actions: For any partner flagged as nearing the rotation limit, request the audit firm's succession plan and proposed replacement partner's background.
Review the proposed replacement's independence letter and experience with the company's tax and actuarial matters.
Present the succession plan to the Audit Committee for concurrence at least one cycle ahead of the mandatory rotation.
Log the succession plan and concurrence date in the rotation tracker.
checklist.done: a concurred succession plan exists in the rotation tracker at least one audit cycle before any mandatory rotation.

checklist.step: Retain independence and rotation records for the required period
actions: Assemble the independence letter, rotation tracker extract, non-audit-service log and engagement acceptance memo for the year.
File the package in the compliance evidence repository under the audit engagement year.
Apply the 7-year retention label.
Confirm the package is indexed and retrievable by engagement year and partner name.
checklist.done: the independence and rotation package is filed, labelled for 7-year retention and retrievable by year and partner.

checklist.step: Report independence status to the Audit Committee at least annually
actions: Present a summary of independence letters received, rotation status, non-audit services approved, and any impairments identified during the year.
Obtain committee acknowledgment of the summary.
Record any directed follow-up action in the minutes.
File the presentation and minutes in the compliance evidence repository.
checklist.done: an annual independence status report is presented to and acknowledged by the Audit Committee, with minutes filed.

testing.step: Build the population of audit and non-audit engagements for the year
actions: Extract every audit and non-audit engagement with the incumbent firm from the AuditBoard engagement log for the fiscal year.
Reconcile the extract to the fees paid per the accounts payable ledger for the audit firm.
Resolve any unreconciled engagement or fee before sampling.
testing.done: the engagement population reconciles to accounts payable records and is signed as complete.

testing.step: Select the sample and document the selection method
actions: Take 100% of non-audit service engagements given typically low volume.
Take a random sample of at least 5 audit-related engagement decisions (acceptance, renewal, scope change) from the year.
Record the seed, population size and selection date in the workpaper.
testing.done: the sample is drawn, reproducible, and covers 100% of non-audit engagements.

testing.step: Verify each sampled non-audit service had documented pre-approval
actions: Pull the pre-approval memo and Audit Committee decision for each sampled non-audit service.
Confirm the approval date pre-dates the service start date.
Confirm the service was not on the prohibited-services list.
Log any unapproved or prohibited service as an exception.
testing.done: every sampled non-audit service has a pre-dated, documented approval, or the exception is logged.

testing.step: Recompute lead/concurring partner tenure against the rotation limits
actions: Pull the engagement partner history for the past 8 years from the rotation tracker and audit firm confirmations.
Recompute consecutive tenure for the lead partner (5-year limit) and concurring partner (7-year limit).
Compare the recomputed tenure to the tracker's recorded value.
Log any discrepancy or missed rotation as an exception.
testing.done: recomputed partner tenure matches the tracker and no rotation limit was exceeded, or the exception is logged.

testing.step: Confirm independence letters were obtained before each engagement letter signature
actions: Compare the independence letter date to the engagement letter signature date for the sampled year(s).
Confirm the independence letter addresses the specific engagement team assigned.
Log any engagement letter signed before the independence letter was received as an exception.
testing.done: every sampled engagement letter was preceded by a dated independence letter, or the exception is logged.

testing.step: Test cooling-off-period compliance for former audit firm employees
actions: Pull the list of finance/accounting hires during the year from HRIS (Workday/SuccessFactors).
Cross-check against the audit firm's alumni list obtained by the Chief Audit Executive.
Confirm no hire into a financial-reporting oversight role violated the cooling-off period.
Log any violation as an exception.
testing.done: no cooling-off-period violation is found among the year's finance hires, or a violation is logged.

testing.step: Trace Audit Committee approvals to the board portal minutes
actions: Open the board portal and locate the minutes for the meeting approving each sampled engagement or non-audit service.
Confirm the minutes reflect the approval and the date matches the AuditBoard record.
Log any unminuted approval as an exception.
testing.done: every sampled approval traces to board portal minutes with a matching date, or the exception is logged.

testing.step: Verify remediation of any prior-year independence finding
actions: Pull any independence finding logged in the prior year's issue log.
Confirm the remediation action described was completed and evidenced.
Log any unremediated or unevidenced prior finding as a repeat exception.
testing.done: every prior-year finding is confirmed remediated with evidence, or logged as a repeat exception.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue for each exception with the engagement, what was missed, and the independence impact.
Assign a root cause and an owner from the Chief Audit Executive's office.
Set a remediation date and, for any material independence impairment, require a self-report assessment with General Counsel.
Carry every open exception into the next cycle's test as a mandatory retest item.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner, remediation date and mandatory retest commitment.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test to the Audit Committee
actions: Compute the exception rate against the zero-unapproved-service and zero-missed-rotation thresholds.
Write the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective) with evidence references.
Have an independent reviewer who did not perform the sampled testing sign the workpaper.
Report results to the Audit Committee and file the signed workpaper in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion and exception rate is filed and reported to the Audit Committee.

checklist.step: Build the year-end close and audit calendar
actions: Draft the close calendar working back from the June 1 statutory annual statement due date and the Form 1120-L due date.
Include audit fieldwork start/end dates agreed with the external auditor's engagement letter.
Circulate the calendar to Tax, Actuarial and Regulatory Reporting for input on their dependent deliverables.
Load the calendar milestones into the filing tracker with T-45/T-30/T-15/T-5 reminders.
checklist.done: an approved close and audit calendar with all filing deadlines and reminders is loaded into the filing tracker.

checklist.step: Prepare and issue the audit prepared-by-client (PBC) list
actions: In BlackLine (Close) open the year-end task list and tag each item required by the auditor's PBC request.
Assign an owner and due date to every PBC item, covering GL reconciliations, reserve support, DAC capitalization workpapers and §831(b) test support where applicable.
Distribute the PBC list to Tax, Actuarial and Accounting teams with the audit fieldwork start date as the hard deadline.
Track PBC completion status daily during the two weeks before fieldwork.
checklist.done: the PBC list is fully assigned, tracked in BlackLine, and complete before audit fieldwork begins.

checklist.step: Close the general ledger and prepare the trial balance
actions: Run the year-end close in SAP S/4HANA (GL): post final adjusting entries, lock the prior period, and generate the trial balance.
Reconcile every material GL account, including reserve, DAC and captive-premium accounts, in BlackLine (Close).
Route unreconciled items to the Controller for resolution before the trial balance is released to audit.
Sign off the close checklist in BlackLine.
checklist.done: the GL is closed, the trial balance is reconciled with no material unresolved item, and the close checklist is signed off.

checklist.step: Prepare draft audited financial statements and footnote disclosures
actions: Draft the statutory and/or GAAP financial statements from the closed trial balance, including the tax footnote disclosing the §831(b), §846 and §848 positions taken.
Cross-check reserve figures in the footnotes to the Appointed Actuary's signed opinion.
Route the draft statements to the CFO for review before sending to the external auditor.
Log the draft version and date in the compliance evidence repository.
checklist.done: draft audited financial statements with tax footnote disclosures are CFO-reviewed and sent to the auditor.

checklist.step: Support audit fieldwork and respond to auditor requests
actions: Assign a daily point of contact to triage new auditor requests during fieldwork.
Log every request and its response date in the PBC tracker.
Escalate any request requiring Tax Director or Appointed Actuary input within one business day of receipt.
Maintain a running list of open audit questions until fieldwork close-out.
checklist.done: all fieldwork requests are logged, responded to, and no request remains open past fieldwork close-out without an escalation record.

checklist.step: Review and resolve proposed audit adjustments
actions: Log every proposed audit adjustment (PAJE) with its dollar impact and the affected account.
Assess each PAJE with the Tax Manager for tax-position impact, particularly on reserve and DAC accounts.
Decide to book or waive each PAJE, with the CFO's sign-off on any waived adjustment above the audit's posted materiality threshold.
Update the trial balance for booked adjustments and re-reconcile affected accounts.
checklist.done: every proposed audit adjustment has a booked/waived disposition signed off at the appropriate authority level.

checklist.step: Obtain and review the draft management representation letter
actions: Request the auditor's draft management representation letter template for the current engagement.
Review each representation against the actual facts known to management, flagging any representation that cannot be truthfully made.
Route flagged items to General Counsel and the CFO for resolution before signature.
Confirm the letter's date will match the audit report date.
checklist.done: the management representation letter is reviewed, any flagged item resolved, and dated to match the audit report.

checklist.step: Obtain the auditor's communication to those charged with governance
actions: Request the auditor's SAS 114/AU-C 260 communication covering significant accounting policies, estimates (including reserve discounting and DAC capitalization), and any disagreement with management.
Review the communication for any item requiring Audit Committee discussion.
Schedule the communication for the Audit Committee's pre-filing meeting.
File the communication letter in AuditBoard.
checklist.done: the auditor's governance communication is obtained, reviewed and scheduled for Audit Committee discussion before filing.

checklist.step: Present the audited financial statements to the Audit Committee for approval
actions: Present the final audited statements, PAJE disposition summary and auditor communication letter to the Audit Committee.
Obtain committee approval to file the audited statements.
Record the approval and meeting date in the board portal minutes.
Notify the Controller and Regulatory Reporting team to proceed with filing.
checklist.done: the Audit Committee's approval to file is minuted before the statements are submitted to regulators.

checklist.step: Sign and issue the management representation letter
actions: Sign the finalized management representation letter alongside the Controller and CEO as required by the engagement letter.
Deliver the signed letter to the audit engagement partner by the date the audit report is to be dated.
File a copy in AuditBoard cross-referenced to the audit engagement.
checklist.done: the signed management representation letter is delivered to the auditor and filed before the audit opinion is issued.

checklist.step: File the audited statutory annual statement with the domiciliary regulator
actions: In the NAIC statutory filing system, upload the audited annual statement package (Jurat page, audited financial statements, actuarial opinion, auditor's report) for the domiciliary state.
Confirm the filing is submitted by June 1 following year-end, or that an approved extension is on file.
Download the filing confirmation/receipt and attach it to the filing tracker.
Repeat the filing for every state requiring a copy per its holding company/annual statement filing requirements.
checklist.done: the audited annual statement is filed with the domiciliary regulator (and copy states) by the deadline, with confirmations on file.

checklist.step: File Form 1120-L with the IRS reflecting the audited reserve and DAC positions
actions: Reconcile the tax return's reserve, DAC and taxable income figures to the audited financial statements' tax footnote.
File Form 1120-L (and consolidated return schedules if applicable) through the IRS Modernized e-File system by the due date or the Form 7004 extended due date.
Retain the e-file acknowledgment (accepted/rejected status) and attach it to the filing tracker.
Notify the Controller once the return is accepted.
checklist.done: Form 1120-L is filed and accepted by the IRS by the due date or extended due date, with the e-file acknowledgment on file.

checklist.step: Communicate any restatement or material weakness disclosed by the audit to regulators
actions: Where the audit identifies a restatement or material weakness, confirm with General Counsel whether a regulatory notification obligation is triggered.
Draft the notification identifying the issue, financial impact and remediation plan.
Route the draft to the CFO and General Counsel for approval before submission.
Submit the notification through the applicable regulator channel and log the submission date.
checklist.done: any triggered restatement/material-weakness notification is approved and submitted to the regulator with the submission date logged.

checklist.step: Reconcile filed figures across the audited statements, annual statement and Form 1120-L
actions: Build a reconciliation schedule tying reserve, DAC and net income figures across the audited GAAP statements, the statutory annual statement, and Form 1120-L, explaining every M-1/M-3 style book-tax difference.
Route the reconciliation to the Controller for review.
File the signed reconciliation in the compliance evidence repository.
checklist.done: a reviewed reconciliation ties figures across all three filings and is filed as supporting evidence.

checklist.step: Retain the full audited-filing package for the required period
actions: Assemble the audited statements, management representation letter, auditor communication letter, PAJE log, filing confirmations and reconciliation schedule.
File the package in the compliance evidence repository under the fiscal year.
Apply the 7-year retention label.
Confirm the package is indexed and retrievable by fiscal year and filing type.
checklist.done: the full audited-filing package is filed, labelled for 7-year retention and retrievable by year and filing type.

testing.step: Build the population of audited financial statement filings for the year
actions: Extract every audited statement filing (statutory annual statement, Form 1120-L, any state copy filings) made during the fiscal year from the filing tracker.
Reconcile the extract to the close calendar's planned filings.
Resolve any unreconciled or missing filing before sampling.
testing.done: the filing population reconciles to the close calendar and is signed as complete.

testing.step: Select the sample and document the selection method
actions: Take 100% of statutory annual statement and Form 1120-L filings given typically low annual volume.
Take a random sample of at least 5 copy-state filings where applicable.
Record the seed, population size and selection date in the workpaper.
testing.done: the sample is drawn, reproducible, and covers 100% of the primary annual filings.

testing.step: Verify each sampled filing was submitted by its statutory deadline
actions: Open the NAIC statutory filing system and pull the submission timestamp for each sampled annual statement filing.
Compare the timestamp to the June 1 statutory deadline or any approved extension.
For Form 1120-L, confirm the IRS e-file acknowledgment date against the due date or extended due date.
Log any late filing without an approved extension as an exception.
testing.done: every sampled filing's submission date is compared to its deadline, with any late filing logged as an exception.

testing.step: Trace filed figures to the underlying audited trial balance
actions: For each sampled filing, trace the reported net income, reserve and DAC figures back to the closed and reconciled trial balance in BlackLine (Close).
Confirm the figures agree, allowing for documented book-tax reconciling items.
Log any unexplained variance as an exception.
testing.done: filed figures trace to the trial balance for every sampled filing, or the variance is logged and explained.

testing.step: Confirm the management representation letter was signed before the audit report date
actions: Pull the signed management representation letter and the audit report for the sampled year.
Compare the representation letter's signature date to the audit report date.
Log any representation letter signed after the audit report date as an exception.
testing.done: the representation letter pre-dates or matches the audit report date for every sampled year, or the exception is logged.

testing.step: Verify proposed audit adjustments were properly dispositioned
actions: Pull the PAJE log for the sampled year and confirm every proposed adjustment has a booked/waived disposition.
Confirm any waived adjustment above the posted materiality threshold carries CFO sign-off.
Recompute the cumulative waived-adjustment impact and compare to the materiality threshold.
Log any missing disposition or unsigned waiver as an exception.
testing.done: every PAJE has a documented, properly authorized disposition, or the gap is logged as an exception.

testing.step: Verify Audit Committee approval preceded filing
actions: Pull the board portal minutes approving the audited statements for the sampled year.
Compare the approval date to the actual filing submission date.
Log any filing submitted before Audit Committee approval as an exception.
testing.done: every sampled filing was submitted after a minuted Audit Committee approval, or the exception is logged.

testing.step: Reconcile figures across audited statements, annual statement and Form 1120-L
actions: Independently rebuild the cross-filing reconciliation schedule for the sampled year.
Compare the independent reconciliation to the Tax Manager's filed reconciliation.
Log any unexplained difference as an exception.
testing.done: the independent reconciliation agrees with the filed reconciliation, or the difference is logged as an exception.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the filing, what was missed, and the regulatory/tax impact.
Assign a root cause and an owner from the Controller's team.
Set a remediation date and, for late filings, confirm whether a penalty or self-report obligation applies.
Carry every open exception into next year's test as a mandatory retest item.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner, remediation date and mandatory retest commitment.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compute the exception rate against the zero-late-filing threshold.
Write the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective) referencing the underlying workpapers.
Have an independent reviewer who performed none of the sampled testing sign the workpaper.
Report results to the Audit Committee and file the signed workpaper in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion and exception rate is filed and reported to the Audit Committee.

checklist.step: Extract in-force non-variable contract data by form and reserve basis
actions: In the actuarial modeling platform run the in-force extract as of the valuation date, filtered to exclude variable contracts under separate account.
Group the extract by contract form number and current statutory reserve method.
Pull net surrender value by contract from the policy administration system (Guidewire PolicyCenter/Duck Creek/ALIP) for the same valuation date.
Reconcile total contract count and reserve amount to the statutory annual statement Exhibit 5/8 (or quarterly equivalent) before proceeding.
checklist.done: the in-force extract is grouped by form and method, net surrender values are attached, and totals reconcile to the statutory exhibit.

checklist.step: Map each contract form to its applicable NAIC reserve method under §807(d)(2)
actions: For each contract form, identify the applicable NAIC method: the Standard Valuation Law method in effect when the contract was issued, per the §807(d)(2) prescribed method table.
Confirm the mapping against the NAIC Valuation Manual (VM-20 or the pre-VM-20 method in force at issue, as applicable).
Flag any form where the statutory method used in the valuation platform differs from the applicable federal tax method.
Document the mapping and any flagged difference in the method-mapping workbook.
checklist.done: every contract form has a documented applicable-NAIC-method determination, with differences from the statutory basis flagged.

checklist.step: Compute the 92.81% factor reserve for each contract form
actions: Take the reserve computed under the applicable NAIC method (statutory-annual-statement basis, adjusted for any flagged method difference) for each contract form.
Multiply by 92.81%, the statutory federally prescribed reserve percentage under §807(d)(1).
Load the computed figures into the tax reserve workbook by form and reporting segment.
checklist.done: the 92.81%-of-NAIC-method reserve is computed and loaded for every contract form.

checklist.step: Compute the greater-of comparison against net surrender value
actions: For each contract, compare the net surrender value to the contract's share of the 92.81% NAIC-method reserve.
Select the greater amount as the deductible federal tax reserve for that contract, per §807(d)(1).
Aggregate the greater-of amounts by contract form and reporting segment.
Flag any contract form where net surrender value exceeds the 92.81% reserve for more than a threshold percentage of contracts, for Appointed Actuary review of the method mapping.
checklist.done: the greater-of comparison is computed and aggregated by form, with any anomalous form flagged for review.

checklist.step: Roll forward the quarterly tax reserve estimate
actions: Take the prior quarter's tax reserve balance and roll forward for new business, terminations, and reserve strengthening/releasing during the quarter.
Compare the rolled-forward estimate to a fresh computation from the current quarter's in-force extract.
Investigate and document any variance beyond the roll-forward tolerance (commonly 1-2% of reserve balance).
Load the quarterly estimate into the estimated tax payment workpaper.
checklist.done: the quarterly roll-forward reserve estimate is computed, variance-checked against a fresh run, and loaded to the payment workpaper.

checklist.step: Compute the annual final tax reserve and the change in reserve for taxable income
actions: Compute the year-end federal tax reserve by form using the year-end in-force extract.
Compute the increase or decrease in reserve from the prior year-end (net of reinsurance ceded per §807(a)(2)) as the deductible/includible reserve change for the year.
Reconcile the reserve change to the reserve line in the tax provision workpaper.
Route the final computation to the Appointed Actuary for review.
checklist.done: the annual final tax reserve and year-over-year change are computed and reconciled to the tax provision workpaper.

checklist.step: Review reinsurance ceded/assumed adjustments to the tax reserve
actions: Pull ceded and assumed reserve credits by treaty from the reinsurance administration system.
Confirm each treaty qualifies for reserve credit under the applicable tax reinsurance rules (risk transfer, proper treaty documentation).
Net the ceded/assumed reserve credits against the gross tax reserve computed by the Reserving Actuary.
Flag any treaty lacking proper documentation for Tax Director review before the credit is taken.
checklist.done: reinsurance reserve credits are verified against treaty documentation and netted into the tax reserve computation.

checklist.step: Prepare the reserve method-mapping and computation workpaper
actions: Assemble the method mapping, 92.81% computation, greater-of comparison and reinsurance adjustment into one workpaper.
Cross-reference each figure to its source extract and computation date.
Route the assembled workpaper to the Appointed Actuary for technical review.
checklist.done: a complete, source-referenced workpaper covering method mapping through final tax reserve is ready for Appointed Actuary review.

checklist.step: Have the Appointed Actuary review and approve the computation
actions: Review the method mapping against the applicable NAIC Valuation Manual provisions and the greater-of computation for reasonableness.
Spot-check a sample of contract-level greater-of comparisons against the underlying policy data.
Sign off the workpaper or return it with review comments for correction.
Log the approval date in the tax reserve workbook.
checklist.done: the Appointed Actuary has signed off the workpaper or returned it with documented comments, with the outcome logged.

checklist.step: Hand the approved reserve figures to Tax for the provision and return
actions: Load the Appointed Actuary-approved reserve change into the tax provision workpaper in OneStream (FP&A).
Cross-check the reserve figure against the GAAP/statutory reserve for the book-tax difference schedule (Schedule M-3 equivalent).
Confirm the figure ties to what will be reported on Form 1120-L, Schedule of reserves.
checklist.done: the approved reserve figure is loaded into the tax provision and reconciled for the book-tax difference schedule.

checklist.step: Update the method mapping for any new contract form or product launch
actions: For every new life/annuity/long-duration health product filed during the year, determine the applicable NAIC reserve method at issue.
Add the new form to the method-mapping workbook before its first in-force valuation date.
Notify the Reserving Actuary of the new form and its method so the extract grouping is current.
checklist.done: every new contract form has a method-mapping entry before its first valuation cycle.

checklist.step: Investigate and resolve any flagged reserve anomaly
actions: Pull the detail behind any contract form flagged for an anomalous net-surrender-value-exceeds-reserve pattern.
Determine whether the anomaly reflects a data issue, a method-mapping error, or a genuine product feature (e.g., a return-of-premium rider).
Document the root cause and, if a correction is needed, direct the Reserving Actuary to rerun the affected form.
Log the resolution in the tax reserve workbook.
checklist.done: every flagged anomaly has a documented root cause and, where needed, a corrected computation.

checklist.step: Reconcile the quarterly estimates to the final annual computation
actions: Compare the sum of quarterly roll-forward estimates to the final annual computation.
Document the drivers of any material difference (true-up items, late-reported business, in-force data corrections).
Route the reconciliation to the Tax Manager for review before the annual return is finalized.
checklist.done: quarterly estimates reconcile to the final annual figure with documented drivers for any material difference.

checklist.step: File the method mapping and computation workpapers in the evidence repository
actions: Assemble the extract, method mapping, computation, reinsurance adjustment and Appointed Actuary sign-off for the tax year.
File the package in the compliance evidence repository under the tax year and reporting segment.
Apply the 7-year retention label.
Confirm the package is indexed and retrievable by tax year and contract form.
checklist.done: the reserve computation package is filed, labelled for 7-year retention and retrievable by year and form.

checklist.step: Brief the Tax Director on the annual reserve computation before filing
actions: Present the final tax reserve figure, method-mapping summary and any anomalies resolved during the year.
Confirm the Tax Director has what is needed to support the reserve line on Form 1120-L on examination.
Record the briefing date and attendees.
File the briefing summary with the computation package.
checklist.done: the Tax Director is briefed on the final reserve computation before it is used in the Form 1120-L filing, with the briefing logged.

testing.step: Build the population of contract forms in scope for the year
actions: Extract the full list of non-variable contract forms in force during the tax year from the actuarial modeling platform.
Reconcile the form count and total reserve to the statutory annual statement exhibit.
Resolve any unreconciled form or reserve difference before sampling.
testing.done: the contract-form population reconciles to the statutory exhibit and is signed as complete.

testing.step: Select the sample and document the selection method
actions: Select 100% of contract forms representing more than 5% of total reserve.
Select a random, reproducible sample of at least 10 additional forms from the remaining population.
Record the seed, population size and selection date in the workpaper.
testing.done: the sample is drawn, reproducible, and covers 100% of material contract forms.

testing.step: Independently re-derive the applicable NAIC method for each sampled form
actions: Pull the contract form's issue date and product filing documentation from the product filing/issue tracker.
Independently determine the applicable NAIC reserve method under §807(d)(2) using the Valuation Manual provisions in force at issue.
Compare the independent determination to the method-mapping workbook.
Log any disagreement as an exception.
testing.done: the independently derived method agrees with the mapping workbook for every sampled form, or the disagreement is logged.

testing.step: Re-perform the 92.81% and greater-of computation on a contract-level sub-sample
actions: For 25 contracts selected from the sampled forms, pull the statutory reserve and net surrender value independently from the actuarial modeling platform and policy administration system.
Recompute 92.81% of the applicable NAIC-method reserve and compare to net surrender value to select the greater amount.
Compare the independent result to the figure in the tax reserve workbook.
Log any variance beyond a de minimis rounding threshold as an exception.
testing.done: the independent contract-level recomputation matches the workbook for every sub-sampled contract, or the variance is logged.

testing.step: Verify reinsurance reserve credits taken against treaty documentation
actions: Pull the treaty documentation for each sampled form's reinsurance reserve credit.
Confirm the treaty was in force for the valuation date and meets risk-transfer requirements for tax reserve credit.
Recompute the ceded reserve credit and compare to the amount netted in the tax reserve computation.
Log any unsupported or miscomputed credit as an exception.
testing.done: every sampled reinsurance credit is supported by treaty documentation and correctly computed, or the exception is logged.

testing.step: Recompute the quarterly roll-forward against the annual final figure
actions: Pull each quarter's roll-forward estimate and the year-end final computation for the tax year.
Recompute the cumulative roll-forward and compare to the final figure.
Confirm any true-up was documented with a driver explanation.
Log any unexplained variance as an exception.
testing.done: the roll-forward reconciles to the final figure with documented drivers, or the unexplained variance is logged.

testing.step: Confirm Appointed Actuary review evidence exists for the sampled forms
actions: Pull the Appointed Actuary's sign-off and any review comments for the tax year's computation.
Confirm the sign-off date pre-dates the return filing date.
Confirm any review comment noted was addressed before finalization.
Log any missing sign-off or unaddressed comment as an exception.
testing.done: Appointed Actuary review evidence exists and pre-dates filing for the tested year, or the gap is logged.

testing.step: Trace the final reserve figure to the tax provision and Form 1120-L
actions: Trace the approved reserve change figure from the workbook into the OneStream (FP&A) tax provision and then into the filed Form 1120-L reserve schedule.
Confirm the figures agree at each step.
Log any unexplained break in the trace as an exception.
testing.done: the reserve figure traces consistently from the workbook through the provision to the filed return, or the break is logged.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the contract form, what was wrong, and the reserve dollar impact.
Assign a root cause (method misclassification, stale in-force data, computation error) and an owner.
Set a remediation date and require any material reserve restatement be flagged to the Tax Director for return-impact assessment.
Carry every open exception into next cycle's test as a mandatory retest item.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner, remediation date and mandatory retest commitment.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compute the exception rate and the aggregate reserve dollar impact of exceptions found.
Write the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective) referencing the underlying workpapers.
Have the Appointed Actuary, as independent reviewer of the testing (having performed none of the sampled re-performance), sign the workpaper.
Report results to the Tax Director and file the signed workpaper in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion, exception rate and reserve impact is filed and reported.

Accountable obligation owner.value: Owns preparation and signature of the statutory Actuarial Opinion and supporting Actuarial Memorandum covering reserves that also underpin the §807(d)(1) federal tax reserve

Citation verified against current regula.value: Yes — opinion content checked against the NAIC Standard Valuation Law/Actuarial Opinion and Memorandum Regulation (Model #822) requirements and cross-referenced to §807(d)(1) so the tax reserve basis and the statutory opinion basis are consistent

In-scope processes.value: Year-end reserve adequacy analysis, actuarial opinion drafting and signature, and actuarial memorandum documentation supporting the opinion and the tax reserve computation

In-scope systems.value: Reserve adequacy models and opinion support run in the actuarial modeling platform; opinion document managed via Microsoft 365 / SharePoint

Compliance procedure documented.value: Actuarial Opinion and Memorandum Preparation Procedure — reserve data pull, adequacy testing scope, opinion qualification criteria, memorandum content checklist per Model #822

Compliance procedure approved.value: Approved by the Chief Actuary; reviewed annually against the current NAIC Actuarial Opinion and Memorandum Regulation

Filing/reporting deadlines tracked.value: Actuarial opinion signed and dated no later than the statutory annual statement due date (March 1 for most states, prior to the June 1 audited statement deadline); memorandum available within required timeframe upon regulator request (commonly 60 days)

Deadline reminders configured.value: Opinion drafting milestone reminders at T-45/T-20/T-5 days before the March 1 statutory filing date

Evidence retained per the retention requ.value: Signed opinion, memorandum and supporting adequacy analysis retained 7 years in the compliance evidence repository

Violations/exceptions logged with dispos.value: Any qualified opinion or adequacy shortfall identified is logged with root cause, disposition and Chief Actuary sign-off

Remediation sign-off captured.value: Chief Actuary signs off any remediation of an opinion qualification before the next valuation cycle

Test population (in-scope transactions,.value: All reserve segments and contract forms covered by the year's actuarial opinion and memorandum

Compliance test frequency matched to the.value: Annual, matching the Annual obligation frequency, tested against each year's opinion cycle

Evidence location for test results.value: Annual actuarial opinion test workpaper in the compliance evidence repository
